design_philosophy: A high-performance command center that feels tactile, organic, and luxurious, tailored for wine and beverage distribution. It merges the sterile efficiency of a Swiss grid with the warm, rich tones of hospitality. Zero generic SaaS blue. Data entry must feel effortless via voice and progressive disclosure.

typography.pairing_strategy: Old Money Tech (High-end Hospitality + SaaS Clarity)
rules: No generic sans-serif for H1/H2. Playfair Display must be used for section titles and key metric numbers to give a premium feel.
Overlines and labels must be Uppercase, text-xs, with tracking-widest.
Body text must be highly legible and sterile to contrast with the expressive headers.
Maximum heading size is text-5xl on desktop, text-3xl on mobile.
Primary Accent (#4A154B - Deep Bordeaux) is strictly for primary CTAs and active states.
Success metrics use a deep earthy Sage/Olive (#2D5A4C), NOT vibrating neon green.
Never use pure black or pure gray. Use tinted charcoal for text.
Support Dark Mode via an elegant toggle: Dark mode background should be #121011 with cards in #1A1819.

layouts.dashboard_grid: High Density Grid (For Dashboards). Tight gaps (gap-4 or gap-6). Use bento-box styling for desktop widgets.
layouts.spacing: Generous Spacing Philosophy. Use p-6 or p-8 inside cards. Always pad text inside bordered containers.
layouts.surfaces: Cardless or subtle roundness (max 8px border-radius). Use 1px subtle borders (border-stone-200) instead of heavy drop shadows.
layouts.glassmorphism: Use 'Crystal Glass' (backdrop-blur-xl bg-white/70 with 1px white border) for sticky headers and floating AI assistants.

components.navigation: Responsive Sidebar on desktop, transforming into a minimalist bottom tab bar or hamburger menu on mobile.
components.ai_assistant_fab: Floating Action Button (fixed, z-50, bottom-right) for Voice-to-Text ('Saisie vocale'). Must have a subtle glowing/pulsing animation ('Tracing Beam' style) to indicate readiness.
components.forms: Ultra-short progressive forms. Only show 1-2 inputs at a time. Use Shadcn Inputs, Selects, and Switches heavily customized with our organic color palette.
components.tables: Shadcn Table with horizontal scroll on mobile. Striped rows in light mode (bg-white/bg-stone-50) for readability.
components.charts: Recharts or Shadcn Charts. Use Bordeaux and Sage tones. No default generic colors.

visual_enhancers.icons: Use lucide-react. Stroke width 1.5 for a clean, sharp look.
visual_enhancers.textures: Subtle noise overlay (opacity 2-3%) on the main app background to give it a physical 'paper' feel.
visual_enhancers.empty_states: Action-oriented. Instead of blank panels, show 'Import clients' or 'Connect catalog' with a soft illustration or icon.

motion.hover_states: -translate-y-[1px] and shadow-sm on interactive cards. Always explicitly set text color on hover.
motion.transitions: Use specific properties (transition-transform, transition-colors duration-200 ease-in-out). DO NOT use 'transition-all'.
motion.voice_recording: When the voice agent is active, show a dynamic equalizer or pulsating ring animation.

responsive.layout_shift: Desktop bento grids must collapse into a single-column vertically stacked feed of KPI cards on mobile.
responsive.progressive_disclosure: On mobile, show ONLY the 'North Star' KPI at the top. Hide secondary stats behind tabs or accordions.
responsive.overflow_guard: Use overflow-x-hidden on the main container. Tables must have their own scrollable wrappers.
responsive.tap_targets: Minimum 44x44px for all buttons and interactive elements on mobile.

accessibility.contrast: Ensure all text meets APCA/WCAG AA standards. High contrast charcoal text on stone backgrounds.
accessibility.data_testid: All interactive elements, forms, and KPI cards MUST include kebab-case data-testid attributes (e.g., 'voice-input-btn', 'sales-kpi-card').

client_bar_context.description: Modern pub/restaurant interior. Use in Client Profile headers or 'Account Management' sections.

product_catalog.description: Wine bottles in cellar. Use for the 'Catalogue Produits' / Inventory preview.

agent_profile.description: Sales professional using a tablet. Use for the 'Manager Dashboard / Agent Performance' placeholder.

instructions_to_main_agent: Build the UI Mobile-First. Collapse multi-column layouts to single columns on mobile screens.
Integrate a bilingual toggle (FR/EN) prominently in the header or sidebar.
The primary feature is 'Voice-to-Text' and 'AI Assistant'. Create a visually distinct floating action button (FAB) for it.
Never center-align the app container (.App { text-align: center; } is FORBIDDEN). Align forms and data to the left.
Use Shadcn UI components but heavily customize them. Strip away Vercel-like borders and apply our 'Organic Precision' colors.
Do not use generic SaaS blue anywhere. Rely on #F7F5F2 for backgrounds and #4A154B for actions.
Header must have a background (e.g., solid or glassmorphism), no completely transparent headers.
Provide mocked functionalities for the 1-click reports, routing (geolocation), and AI summary metrics.
Add data-testid to every button, input, and interactive card.
